Added a reproducible scalar-loss snapshot of all nine terminal deferred fits, retaining the tenth declared attempt (OASIS17 step-scaled) as pending. Verified source/protocol seals, terminal event/log hashes and final map/validity hashes: all eight fits with historical baselines replay exactly; OASIS1 step-scaled has no baseline. All nine exit 0, but the 18 levels end at 14 accepted-step budgets and 4 controller exhaustions, not convergence.

Across 280 accepted updates and 24 rejections, checked state continuity and telescoping frozen-trial improvement minus support/weight-rebuild change equals net rebuilt loss decrease, separately per level. One accepted update increases rebuilt loss: OASIS13 control fine update1/event24, frozen drop 0.000085119071 followed by rebuild increase 0.000318078901, net increase 0.000232959830. Most cumulative scalar decrease survives rebuilding; positive-support counts decrease on 168 updates, which does not identify common voxels or establish an anatomical cause. Fixed-region and anatomy scoring remain required. Three accounting regression tests pass. Artifact docs/benchmarks/evidence/halfflow-deferred-capture-20261014/scalar-loss-snapshot-v1; report halfflow-deferred-capture-v1.md.

The first 29-export batch and scorer remain active. Keep the next 61-export batch held until the declared isolated reference timing study completes. No optimizer policy or threshold changed; D01/D02 remain open.
